integrity: The mathematical derivation and standalone numerical checker were examined; numerical tests are consistency evidence rather than an infinite proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Requires a fixed geodesic radius, fixed dimension n >= 2 and true normalized hyperbolic-volume sampling on a constant-curvature ball; no nonconstant-curvature result, uniform moving-parameter asymptotic, or arbitrary-n complete distance law. The 3D exact upper-half formula uses positive curvature magnitude. Independent mathematical validation and absolute historical priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Fixed-radius hyperbolic-ball diameter tails and curvature identification
